# Spændende muligheder i Finland - sådan spotter du vinderne

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-09-30  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This Danish Millionærklubben episode, with Michael Friis Jørgensen (H.C. Andersen Capital) and Lars Skovgaard Andersen (Danske Bank), opens with macro: oil flows are recovering, US yields are at records, US consumer confidence is weak and the Fed is unlikely to cut, while equities hold up. It then reviews Danish stocks: B&O's leaked quarterly report was decent, and NKT is a strong long-term case but expensive. The main theme is Finland: a cyclical market recovering from losing its Russia trade, with rising earnings estimates, a P/E of about 18 and a tech-rich small/mid-cap segment fed by former Nokia engineers. The guests favour Finnish tech, data-centre builders and domestic consumption (banks, housing).

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟡 NKT — NKT | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Guest Michael owns it and calls it a very strong long-term structural case into the 2030s. He says it is expensive and wants to add near 800 DKK.

#### Reasoning

The order book is filled until 2028 and the Karlskrona factory is ahead of schedule, so the big risks are largely gone. At the CMD, management admitted heavy working-capital needs, meaning less cash returned to shareholders. Michael sold near 1100 and holds the rest. He says the stock is pricey, so investors should be careful about sizing, and he would buy more if it fell toward 800.

#### Sell Triggers

- if working-capital needs keep investors from receiving cash
- if energy-transition project demand weakens
- if valuation stretches further without earnings delivery

> *"rigtig, rigtig stærk, langsigtet strukturelt case. Så langt ind i 30'erne, vi overhovedet kan se. Jeg ejer den."*

---

### 🟠 BO — Bang & Olufsen | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Michael found the leaked report decent, with growth back and good sell-out. Investors are waiting for the new CEO from Alexander McQueen to set a direction.

#### Reasoning

After a period of disappointments, B&O delivered 2.5% growth, OK gross margin and cash flow, and healthy sell-out in its own stores. It was a small quarter, so there is little to learn from it. The catalyst will be the new luxury-industry CEO's strategy, which investors usually buy into more than a single report.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the new CEO's strategy disappoints
- if sell-out growth reverses

> *"Så efter en periode, hvor BRO jo har skuffet, så er det egentlig et ganske glemrende regnskab"*
